resolution.note: slice pre-commit runs scripts/test-suite.mjs with test/rules expanded by the runner

title: Run slice pre-commit checks through the test suite runner
body:
Outcome: krn slice run --worker none runs the brief observers and test/rules through scripts/test-suite.mjs, as krn verify targeted does. Today src/slice/run.ts (pre-commit step) runs mise exec node -- node --test <observers> test/rules: Node treats the directory test/rules as a module (Cannot find module .../test/rules) and observers miss KRN_ISOLATION_CAPABILITIES, so every lead-edit slice stops at stage worker with exit 1 (seen on t-zsqwrey, .krn/runs/slice/t-zsqwrey/pre-commit.log).
Workaround: run the observers and test/rules by hand with node scripts/test-suite.mjs, commit the implementation with the runner's trailers, set implementationCommitted and stage worker in the journal, then rerun slice run.
Proof: test/slice/slice-run.test.ts asserts the pre-commit argv runs scripts/test-suite.mjs with expanded test/rules files.
